messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's current action with the action demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's current action with the one demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands on an asphalt road, initially looking to his left, then turns to face forward and raises his right hand to touch his chest and collar before lowering it.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot that keeps the subject centered in the frame.","clothing":"A dark blue military-style uniform with a high collar, gold buttons, gold star insignia on the chest, a black belt with a gold buckle, and black shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair combed back from the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered adult male with a slim build, short dark hair, and a neutral face.","scene":"An outdoor paved area beneath a concrete overpass or bridge structure, with a metal railing, red-and-yellow striped posts, and a bright blue sky with light clouds in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The man now performs a similar sequence: standing, turning toward the camera, raising his right hand to touch his chest/collar area, then lowering it. His uniform, bridge scene, low-angle framing, and overall appearance remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the man's current action with the motion shown in the reference, while preserving his identity, uniform, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: The exact timing and details of the transferred motion are not perfectly aligned with the reference, but the main gesture is present.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly darker or have a different exposure than the source frames.
